PUNJAB SUPERINTENDS OF POLICE
PUNJAB SUPERINTENDS OF POLICE
SERVICE RULES, 2008
(Amendment of column 10)
[Gazette of Punjab, Part I,
12th December, 2012]
No.1631/EXEC-II,
dated 5-5-2012.---In exercise of the powers conferred by Article 112 of the
Police Order, 2002, the Provincial Police Officer with the approval of the
Government is pleased to make the following amendments in the Punjab
Superintends of Police Service Rules, 2008:--
"In
Column 10 the condition regarding "Field Experience" is deleted.
